headline: Pilgrim's Confirms Investment in Mexico and Sees Opportunity Amid Restrictions on Brazilian Chicken
summary: Pilgrim's confirmed an investment in Mexico and sees an opportunity amid restrictions on Brazilian chicken. The investment would allow Mexico to stop importing about 35% of its chicken.
why: Pilgrim's Pride is a major US-listed poultry producer with operations in Mexico, and import substitution shifts poultry trade flows between producers.
original_headline: Pilgrim’s confirma inversión en México y ve oportunidad ante restricciones al pollo de Brasil
